body: A very gentle, nourishing full-body Ayurvedic oil application designed for infants and young children aged 1 to 5. Using mild traditional oils such as Lakshadi Keram or Nalpamaradi Keram, the therapist works with light, nurturing strokes to support skin health, bone density and healthy weight gain during these formative early years.

The session is rhythmic and deeply soothing rather than deep-tissue. Every detail — the choice of oil, its temperature and the duration — is custom-selected for your child following a mandatory pre-therapy consultation with our Ayurveda Vaidya, who assesses your little one's constitution and sensitivity beforehand.
benefits: Improves the quality and depth of sleep
Relieves common discomforts such as colic and gas
Calms Vata for a settled, contented child

procedureSteps.title: Calming close
procedureSteps.description: The session settles into a soothing, restful finish to leave your child calm and comfortable.

body: A cooling combination treatment for teenagers aged 12 to 17, bringing together a head massage, a cooling herbal scalp wrap known as Talam, and a Sirodhaara stream of medicated buttermilk. It is especially suited to those with high body heat, stress or sleep issues.

The treatment supports good sleep and helps reduce body heat. The herbal preparations, temperature, duration and combination are custom-selected for your teenager by our Ayurveda Vaidya during the mandatory pre-therapy consultation.
